summary: Aotearoa (New Zealand), software developer with 30+ years of experience, strong interest in open-source software and Linux, critical of Apple and Node.js, advocates for drug legalization and social justice, engaged in discussions about systemic racism and police reform, enjoys gardening and cooking, has a critical view of capitalism and economic inequality, supports diversity and inclusion in tech, skeptical of cryptocurrency, interested in psychedelics and their societal implications, values community and personal responsibility.
